fusions.name: Skipping Stones
fusions.desc: Skims a stone that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets, then leaps to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 60% of the damage. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Wing Buffet
fusions.desc: Beats a spray of water 4 tiles ahead of you that deals 26 water damage to everything in it and leaves them [Soaked] for 6 seconds. It ignores resistances.

fusions.name: Water off the Back
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it instead.

fusions.name: Unflustered
fusions.desc: Once every 8 seconds, a failed dodge is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
